title: DAAD Scholarships

nationality.description: Eligibility depends on the specific DAAD scholarship programme and its country-specific rules.

academicPerformance.description: Academic requirements vary by scholarship programme and host institution.

english.description: Language requirements depend on the selected programme and university.

workExperience.description: Some DAAD programmes, particularly development-related programmes, require or prefer relevant professional experience.

additionalRequirements.label: DAAD programme-specific eligibility
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must satisfy the academic, admission, language and programme-specific requirements of the selected DAAD scholarship.

description: Major German scholarship programmes supporting international students and researchers across a wide range of study levels and fields.

title: DAAD EPOS Scholarship

nationality.description: Primarily intended for applicants from developing and emerging countries eligible under the programme.

academicPerformance.description: Strong academic performance is expected and exact requirements vary by selected EPOS course.

english.description: English or German language requirements depend on the selected programme.

workExperience.description: Applicants must have at least two years of relevant professional experience after completing their bachelor's degree.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible EPOS programme
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must apply to a participating development-related postgraduate course listed under the current EPOS programme.

description: DAAD development-related postgraduate scholarship programme for qualified applicants from developing and emerging countries.

title: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt Programme

nationality.description: Designed for graduates from developing and emerging countries meeting the programme's eligibility rules.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must demonstrate strong academic performance.

english.description: Language requirements depend on the selected master's programme.

workExperience.description: Relevant practical experience is valued by the programme.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible Helmut-Schmidt master's programme
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must apply to one of the participating master's programmes covered by the current Helmut-Schmidt call.

description: DAAD programme supporting future leaders from developing and emerging countries through selected master's programmes related to governance and public policy.

title: Chevening Scholarship

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must hold an undergraduate degree that meets the requirements for the selected UK master's programme.

english.description: Chevening does not impose a separate English test score requirement; applicants must meet the selected university's requirements.

workExperience.description: Applicants need at least 2,800 hours of work experience acquired after completing an undergraduate degree.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible UK master's course
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must apply to eligible full-time taught master's courses at UK universities.

additionalRequirements.label: Return to home country
additionalRequirements.description: Successful scholars must satisfy the programme's post-study return requirement.

description: The UK Government's flagship international scholarship programme for future leaders.

title: Commonwealth Master's Scholarship

academicPerformance.description: Applicant must satisfy the academic requirements of the scholarship and selected UK institution.

english.description: English requirements are determined by the selected UK university and course.

additionalRequirements.label: Development impact
additionalRequirements.description: The proposed study should contribute to development priorities in the applicant's home country.

additionalRequirements.label: Return to home country
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must satisfy the scholarship's conditions concerning return to their home country.

description: UK-funded master's scholarships for talented citizens of eligible low and middle income Commonwealth countries.

title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarship

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must meet the academic requirements of the selected participating university.

additionalRequirements.label: Participating UK university
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must apply through a participating UK university offering a Commonwealth Shared Scholarship.

additionalRequirements.label: Return to home country
additionalRequirements.description: Scholarship conditions require the scholar to return to their home country after study.

description: UK scholarship programme supporting students from eligible developing Commonwealth countries through participating universities.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program

academicPerformance.description: Academic requirements are determined by the applicable country programme and U.S. graduate programme.

english.description: English requirements vary by country programme and university.

additionalRequirements.label: Country-specific Fulbright programme
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must satisfy the current Fulbright Foreign Student Program requirements for their country.

additionalRequirements.label: U.S. graduate admission
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must satisfy the admission requirements of their applicable U.S. graduate programme.

description: Major U.S. government scholarship programme supporting international graduate students and researchers.

title: Australia Awards Scholarships

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must hold the required tertiary qualification and satisfy the Bangladesh country profile and university requirements.

workExperience.description: Country-specific requirements and priority employment profiles may apply.

additionalRequirements.label: Bangladesh country-specific eligibility
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must satisfy the current Bangladesh Australia Awards country profile, including citizenship, employment, priority-field and return requirements.

additionalRequirements.label: Minimum English requirement
additionalRequirements.description: The current Bangladesh profile requires IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with no individual band below 6.0, subject to official exceptions.

description: Australian Government scholarship programme supporting students from participating developing countries to undertake study in Australia.

title: MEXT Scholarship

nationality.description: Applicants must satisfy the nationality conditions of the applicable MEXT recruitment route.

academicPerformance.description: Academic requirements vary by MEXT category and recruitment route.

age.description: Age requirements depend on the recruitment year and MEXT category.

additionalRequirements.label: MEXT category requirements
additionalRequirements.description: Eligibility depends on the selected MEXT category, recruitment route, academic level, field and current official guidelines.

description: Japanese Government scholarship programme supporting international students from undergraduate through doctoral level.

title: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must have a CGPA of at least 2.64/4.0, 2.80/4.3, 2.91/4.5 or 3.23/5.0, or meet the required 100-point percentile/top-20% criterion.

age.description: Age limits depend on the degree level and current GKS guidelines.

additionalRequirements.label: Embassy or University Track
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must apply through an applicable Korean embassy or designated university according to the current GKS guidelines.

description: South Korean Government scholarship programme for international students at undergraduate and graduate levels.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)

nationality.description: Applicants must be citizens of eligible countries under the applicable Chinese Government Scholarship route.

academicPerformance.description: Academic criteria depend on the scholarship category and selected university.

english.description: Language requirements depend on whether the programme is taught in Chinese or English.

age.description: Age limits are degree-specific: Master's applicants must not exceed 28 years, while PhD applicants must not exceed 30 years under the current call.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible CSC scholarship route
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must satisfy the requirements of the applicable Chinese Government Scholarship category and host university.

description: Chinese Government scholarship programme supporting international students across multiple degree levels and disciplines.

title: Italian Government MAECI Scholarship

nationality.description: Bangladesh is included among eligible countries under the applicable annual call.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must satisfy the academic admission requirements of the selected Italian programme.

english.description: Language requirements depend on the selected programme.

age.description: Age limits vary by scholarship category and the current annual call.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible Italian institution or programme
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must apply to an eligible academic programme or research activity covered by the current MAECI call.

description: Italian Government scholarship programme for foreign students pursuing eligible study and research programmes in Italy.

title: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs

nationality.description: The programme targets foreign students; exact country eligibility follows the current annual call.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must demonstrate strong academic performance and satisfy the selected French institution's requirements.

age.description: For master's applicants, the current programme generally targets candidates under 30; doctoral limits are higher.

additionalRequirements.label: French institution nomination
additionalRequirements.description: Applications must be submitted by eligible French higher education institutions rather than directly by students.

description: French Government scholarship programme designed to attract high-level international students to French higher education.

title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals

nationality.description: Applicants must be citizens of countries included in the current SI eligible-country list.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must meet the academic admission requirements of their selected Swedish master's programme.

workExperience.description: Relevant professional experience requirements depend on the current SI call.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible Swedish master's programme
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must apply to an eligible master's programme covered by the current Swedish Institute scholarship call.

description: Swedish Institute scholarship programme supporting international professionals pursuing eligible master's programmes in Sweden.

title: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship

nationality.description: Applicants must be from a non-EU/non-EEA country eligible under the annual call.

academicPerformance.description: Strong academic performance is expected.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible Irish institution offer
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must have an offer from an eligible Irish higher education institution before completing the scholarship application.

description: Irish Government scholarship supporting high-calibre international students from non-EU and non-EEA countries.

title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships

nationality.description: Eligibility depends on the current participating-country list and country-specific priorities.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must satisfy the academic requirements of the selected programme.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible Manaaki country
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must be a citizen of an eligible country and meet the current country-specific priority requirements.

additionalRequirements.label: Return and contribute to home country
additionalRequirements.description: Scholars are expected to return to their home country and contribute to its development.

description: New Zealand Government scholarship programme for students from eligible developing countries.

title: Danish Government Scholarships

nationality.description: Eligibility depends on the participating Danish university and current scholarship scheme.

academicPerformance.description: Academic requirements are determined by the participating university.

english.description: English requirements depend on the selected Danish programme.

additionalRequirements.label: Participating Danish university
additionalRequirements.description: Availability, funding level and eligibility depend on the participating university and its current scholarship call.

description: Government-supported scholarships administered through participating Danish higher education institutions.

title: NL Scholarship
provider: Dutch Ministry of Education and Participating Institutions

nationality.description: The scholarship targets non-EEA students; exact eligibility depends on the participating institution.

academicPerformance.description: Academic requirements are determined by the participating institution.

additionalRequirements.label: Participating Dutch institution
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must apply to a participating Dutch higher education institution and satisfy its programme-specific requirements.

description: Scholarship for non-EEA international students offered through participating Dutch higher education institutions.

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters

nationality.description: Students from around the world are eligible to apply, subject to the requirements of the selected joint master's programme.

academicPerformance.description: Academic requirements vary by the selected Erasmus Mundus master's programme.

english.description: English or other language requirements depend on the selected consortium.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible Erasmus Mundus Joint Master
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must apply to an eligible Erasmus Mundus Joint Master programme and satisfy its consortium-specific admission requirements.

description: European Union-funded international master's programmes delivered by university consortia across multiple countries, with full scholarships available.

title: Rhodes Scholarship

nationality.description: Eligibility depends on the applicant's applicable Rhodes constituency or accepted inter-jurisdictional route.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must demonstrate strong academic achievement and satisfy the relevant Rhodes and Oxford course requirements.

english.description: Applicants must satisfy the applicable Oxford English-language requirements.

age.description: Age and degree-completion requirements depend on the applicable Rhodes constituency and annual cycle.

additionalRequirements.label: Rhodes constituency eligibility
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must qualify under the applicable Rhodes constituency or accepted inter-jurisdictional route.

additionalRequirements.label: Oxford course eligibility
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must meet the academic and admission requirements for an eligible Oxford postgraduate course.

description: Prestigious international scholarship supporting outstanding postgraduate students at the University of Oxford.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship

nationality.description: Open to international applicants subject to the programme's course and nationality rules.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants should demonstrate outstanding academic achievement.

english.description: English requirements are determined by the selected Cambridge course.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible Cambridge postgraduate course
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must apply to an eligible postgraduate programme at the University of Cambridge.

additionalRequirements.label: Cambridge admission
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must satisfy the admission requirements of the selected Cambridge course.

description: Fully funded scholarship for outstanding international postgraduate students at the University of Cambridge.

title: Clarendon Fund Scholarship

nationality.description: Open to applicants of all nationalities applying to eligible Oxford graduate programmes.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants should demonstrate excellent academic potential.

additionalRequirements.label: Oxford graduate application
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must apply for an eligible Oxford graduate course before the relevant course deadline.

description: Oxford graduate scholarship providing full tuition and a living grant to academically outstanding students.

title: Schwarzman Scholars

nationality.description: Applicants from around the world may apply subject to programme eligibility.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must demonstrate strong academic achievement.

age.description: Applicants must meet the programme's age requirement for the relevant enrollment year.

additionalRequirements.label: Undergraduate degree
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must have completed or be on track to complete an undergraduate degree by the programme's specified deadline.

description: Fully funded international leadership scholarship for a master's degree at Tsinghua University.

title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program
provider: World Bank and Government of Japan

nationality.description: Applicants must be nationals of a World Bank member developing country listed under the current programme eligibility rules.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must have a bachelor's degree and satisfy the selected participating master's programme.

workExperience.description: Applicants generally need relevant professional experience after completing their bachelor's degree.

additionalRequirements.label: Participating master's programme
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must apply to an approved JJ/WBGSP participating master's programme.

additionalRequirements.label: Development-related career
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants should demonstrate a commitment to development-related work.

description: Scholarship programme supporting professionals from eligible developing countries to pursue selected development-related master's degrees.

title: Islamic Development Bank Scholarship Program

nationality.description: Eligibility depends on the applicable IsDB scholarship programme and eligible-country list.

academicPerformance.description: Strong academic performance is generally required.

age.description: Age limits depend on the selected IsDB scholarship programme.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible IsDB country
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must be a citizen of an eligible IsDB member or participating country under the applicable programme.

additionalRequirements.label: Priority field
additionalRequirements.description: Some IsDB scholarship tracks prioritize science, technology, medicine, engineering and other development-related disciplines.

description: Recurring Islamic Development Bank scholarship programmes supporting students from eligible member and participating countries.

title: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme

nationality.description: Eligibility depends on the annual geographic eligibility list and programme rules.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must demonstrate strong academic performance.

english.description: Applicants must meet the language requirements of the selected university.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible geographic region
additionalRequirements.description: Applicant must be from a country or territory covered by the current scholarship programme.

additionalRequirements.label: Financial need
additionalRequirements.description: The programme considers applicants who require financial assistance to pursue postgraduate study.

description: International postgraduate scholarship programme providing financial assistance to talented students from selected developing countries.

title: Rotary Peace Fellowship

nationality.description: Applicants from around the world may apply, subject to programme and host-centre requirements.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must demonstrate strong academic performance.

workExperience.description: Relevant work or volunteer experience related to peace and development is required.

additionalRequirements.label: Relevant professional or volunteer experience
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must demonstrate relevant experience in peace, development, conflict resolution or related areas.

description: Fully funded postgraduate fellowship for professionals pursuing peace and development studies.

title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
provider: Swiss Confederation / Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students

nationality.description: Eligibility and available scholarship types depend on the applicant's country of origin and the annual Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships call.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must demonstrate a strong academic profile appropriate for doctoral-level research.

english.description: Language requirements depend on the research project, host institution and programme.

researchExperience.description: Research competence and the quality of the proposed research project are important selection criteria.

additionalRequirements.label: Swiss academic supervisor
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants for research and doctoral scholarships must identify an academic supervisor at a Swiss higher education institution who supports the proposed research project.

additionalRequirements.label: Research project
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must submit a suitable research proposal and satisfy the academic requirements of the selected Swiss institution.

description: Swiss Government scholarship programme supporting international researchers and doctoral candidates through study and research opportunities at Swiss higher education institutions.

title: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
provider: Government of Hungary / Tempus Public Foundation

nationality.description: Eligibility depends on the annual sending-partner agreement and eligible-country arrangements for the Stipendium Hungaricum programme.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must satisfy the academic requirements of the selected Hungarian institution and programme.

english.description: Language requirements are determined by the selected programme and host institution.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible sending partner
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must be eligible under the applicable sending partner and country-specific conditions.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible Hungarian institution
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must apply to an eligible Hungarian higher education institution and programme available under the current call.

description: Hungarian Government scholarship programme offering international students opportunities to study at Hungarian higher education institutions across multiple degree levels.

title: Türkiye Scholarships
provider: Government of Türkiye / Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities

nationality.description: Türkiye Scholarships are open to international applicants from eligible countries worldwide, subject to the current programme criteria.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must satisfy the academic performance requirements applicable to their selected degree level and programme.

english.description: Language requirements depend on the selected university and academic programme.

age.description: Age requirements depend on the degree level and current Türkiye Scholarships criteria.

additionalRequirements.label: Türkiye Scholarships programme placement
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must satisfy the scholarship programme's placement and programme-selection requirements.

additionalRequirements.label: Programme-specific eligibility
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must satisfy the academic, age and programme-specific requirements of the selected Turkish university and degree programme.

description: Turkish Government scholarship programme providing international students with financial support, university placement and comprehensive study benefits.

title: Knight-Hennessy Scholars

nationality.description: Applicants from all countries and nationalities are encouraged to apply, subject to Stanford graduate programme eligibility.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must be admitted to an eligible Stanford graduate programme and demonstrate strong academic and personal potential.

english.description: Applicants must satisfy the English-language requirements of their selected Stanford graduate programme.

additionalRequirements.label: Stanford graduate admission
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must apply to and be admitted to an eligible full-time Stanford graduate degree programme.

additionalRequirements.label: Undergraduate degree date
additionalRequirements.description: For the 2027 cohort, applicants must have earned their first bachelor's degree in January 2020 or later, with an extended window for eligible military applicants.

description: Stanford University's multidisciplinary graduate scholarship programme supporting outstanding students from around the world through funding and leadership development.

title: Romanian Government MFA Scholarship
benefits: Preparatory Romanian Language Year When Applicable

nationality.description: Open to citizens of non-EU countries subject to the exclusions and conditions in the current Romanian Government scholarship call.

academicPerformance.description: Applicants must have at least the equivalent of 7.0 on the Romanian grading scale. For a 4.0 GPA scale, the official equivalent is 2.8/4.0.

english.description: Language requirements depend on the selected programme; Romanian-language preparatory study may apply where required.

additionalRequirements.label: Non-EU nationality
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must be citizens of a non-EU country and satisfy the exclusions and eligibility rules in the current Romanian Government call.

additionalRequirements.label: Eligible Romanian programme
additionalRequirements.description: Applicants must select an eligible programme and institution covered by the Romanian Ministry of Foreign Affairs scholarship scheme.

description: Romanian Government scholarship programme supporting eligible non-EU international students at Romanian higher education institutions.
